quantize_4bit_blockwise_triton: quantize a PyTorch tensor blockwise to FP4 or NF4 format using Triton kernels
dequantize_4bit_impl: dequantize FP4 or NF4 quantized tensor data back to floating point using Triton
dequantize_4bit_impl_passing_code: dequantize quantized tensor data using a custom codebook tensor with Triton kernels
quantize_4bit_blockwise_kernel: quantize a tensor to 4-bit indices using a codebook-based binary search approach
dequantize_fp4_kernel: dequantize FP4 packed uint8 data to floating point using a Triton tree kernel
